description: This file defines the class 'FieldDefinition' which is used for defining entity field definitions within the Drupal CMS. It includes methods for managing field properties, storage definitions, display options, default values, and translatability.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Field\FieldDefinition
classes.description: A class for defining entity field definitions, managing properties, storage, display, default values, and translatability within Drupal.

methods.name: createFromFieldStorageDefinition
methods.description: Creates a new FieldDefinition instance from a given field storage definition.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the field.

methods.name: getTargetEntityTypeId
methods.description: Returns the target entity type ID.

methods.name: setTargetBundle
methods.description: Sets the target bundle for the field.

methods.name: getTargetBundle
methods.description: Gets the target bundle for the field.

methods.name: setDisplayConfigurable
methods.description: Sets whether the display for the field can be configured.

methods.name: isDisplayConfigurable
methods.description: Checks if the display is configurable.

methods.name: setDisplayOptions
methods.description: Sets display options for the field in forms or rendered entities.

methods.name: getDisplayOptions
methods.description: Retrieves display options for a given display context.

methods.name: getDefaultValueLiteral
methods.description: Gets the default value literal.

methods.name: setDefaultValueCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback function for default value generation.

methods.name: getDefaultValueCallback
methods.description: Retrieves the default value callback.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets a default value for the field.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Gets the default value for a given entity, considering callbacks and processing.

methods.name: setTranslatable
methods.description: Sets whether the field is translatable.

methods.name: isTranslatable
methods.description: Checks if the field is translatable.

methods.name: setFieldStorageDefinition
methods.description: Associates a field storage definition with this field definition.

methods.name: getFieldStorageDefinition
methods.description: Returns the associated field storage definition.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving override configuration (not implemented).

methods.name: getUniqueIdentifier
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the field based on entity type, bundle, and name.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Retrieves a specific setting for the field.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves all combined settings for the field.

methods.name: setSetting
methods.description: Sets a specific setting for the field.

methods.name: setSettings
methods.description: Sets multiple settings for the field.
